gems.title: 欢迎来龙餐馆
gems.titleEn: Once Upon a Time in the Middle East
gems.summary: 徐福为养家还债远赴中东中餐馆当厨师，在当地结识了大堂经理马俊生。他们以地道中国风味广招八方来客，龙餐馆声名鹊起。然而随着战争爆发，当地形势急转直下，没有人能够独善其身，徐福和马俊生也不例外，他们的命运将何去何从？战火中的龙餐馆又将如何维系？
gems.summaryEn: Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to work as a chef in a Chinese restaurant to pay off family debts, where he meets floor manager Ma Junsheng. Their Dragon Restaurant rises to fame, attracting crowds w
gems.whyWatch: 战争阴影下一家中国餐馆的生死沉浮，罕见题材与高分口碑不容错过。
gems.whyWatchEn: A rare war drama centered on a Chinese restaurant's struggle, with outstanding ratings and an unforgettable human story.
gems.audience: 喜欢战争史诗、海外华人故事与人性拷问的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of war epics, overseas Chinese stories, and moral depths.

gems.title: 维什瓦纳特父子
gems.summary: 桑贾伊·维什瓦纳特是一位备受赞誉的专业手枪射击运动员，年过四十，在名利场上可谓功成名就。然而，当他与二十多岁的女孩玛迪相遇后，两人之间因较大的年龄差距产生了种种碰撞与问题，迫使他们不得不重新审视并坦然面对。
gems.summaryEn: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that th
gems.whyWatch: 印度名射手的忘年恋与中年审视，细腻克制又动人。
gems.whyWatchEn: A poignant, restrained drama about an Indian champion shooter's age-gap romance and midlife reckoning.
gems.audience: 偏爱成熟爱情与人物内心戏的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers who prefer mature romance and deep character interiority.

gems.title: 属于我的孩子
gems.summary: 在这部令人震惊的纪录片中，承受家人和社会的期望的女子迫切地想要个孩子，因此假装怀孕，并卷入一起犯罪。
gems.summaryEn: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.
gems.whyWatch: 假装怀孕而卷入犯罪，真实案件的震撼纪录揭示女性困境。
gems.whyWatchEn: A shocking documentary about a fake pregnancy spiraling into crime, exposing immense social pressure on women.
gems.audience: 关注女性议题与真实犯罪纪录片的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Viewers interested in women's issues and true-crime documentaries.

gems.title: 我们未曾有过的
gems.summary: 改编自爱丽丝·凯伦（Alice Kellen）同名畅销小说。失去父母后，有志成为画家的利亚（Leah）难以应对。当她的哥哥搬走后，他请最好的朋友阿克塞尔（Axel）照顾她，却不知道她对他一直以来的感情。
gems.summaryEn: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grap
gems.whyWatch: 改编自畅销小说的青春暗恋与失去，情感细腻如潮水。
gems.whyWatchEn: A tender adaptation about grief, friendship, and hidden love that quietly sweeps you away.
gems.audience: 喜欢青春文学改编与细腻情感电影的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Fans of YA adaptations and emotionally nuanced dramas.

gems.title: 末世行者
gems.summary: 一场大流行病席卷全球后，人口锐减。在科罗拉多州的飞机库里，一名男子与他的狗和一位阴郁的枪手相伴过着孤寂的生活。当他驾驶着老旧的塞斯纳飞机时，无线电里突然传来神秘的信号，由此引发了一场追寻声音来源的探索之旅。
gems.summaryEn: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmis
gems.whyWatch: 末世中人与狗和无线电信号，极简科幻氛围孤独迷人。
gems.whyWatchEn: A lonely post-apocalyptic journey with a man, his dog, and a mysterious radio signal — minimal sci-fi at its most atmospheric.
gems.audience: 享受安静氛围、末日孤独与公路式科幻的观众。
gems.audienceEn: Those who enjoy quiet, lonely post-apocalyptic and road-movie sci-fi.
